title: Homework Assignment Variety by Month
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=therapy:homework
| stats dc(assignment_type) as assignment_types count as assignments by month
| sort 0 - assignment_types
description: Ranks monthss by homework assignment variety.
value: Assignment variety shows whether the between-session work is broad enough to keep building different skills.
implementation: Send homework assignment variety events to `index=personal` and keep `month` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of homework assignment variety by months.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which monthss stand out most for homework assignment variety.
